characters.name: Moussa
characters.description: A fundamentally honest teenager whose impulsive truancy leaves him trapped between integrity and embarrassment.
characters.appearance: Slim short teenage boy, alert forward posture, rounded face, large almond eyes, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow.

visual_persona.art_style: painterly 3D animated illustration with textured brushwork, expressive proportions, warm cinematic highlights, and rich cool shadows

visual_persona.color_palette: coral T-shirt, navy knee-length shorts, mustard sneakers, and a faded blue crossbody satchel
visual_persona.distinctive_elements: faded blue crossbody satchel and a thin woven bracelet on his right wrist
visual_persona.expression_type: curious and open, shifting quickly into wide-eyed nervousness

shots.text: This story is brought to you by Mot Flow.
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — vertical 9:16 painted title card, flowing amber path crossing deep-blue texture, centered text reading "Mot Flow" in Comic Sans MS, painterly 3D animated illustration with textured brushwork
shots.pose: No character; centered graphic arrangement
shots.action: Amber path curls behind the title
shots.background_mood: Inviting cream glow over deep blue

shots.text: Today, we tell the story of a boy who finds a black bag at the market,
shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, slim short sixteen-year-old boy with alert forward posture, rounded face, large dark almond eyes, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow — vertical 9:16 low-angle market composition, Moussa noticing a black bag between produce stalls, wearing coral T-shirt, navy shorts, mustard sneakers, faded blue satchel
shots.pose: Mid-step, torso turning toward the ground
shots.action: He notices the abandoned black bag
shots.background_mood: Bustling sunlit market with warm suspense

shots.text: and the owner of that bag is the last person he wants to meet.
shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, large dark almond eyes tightening beneath short curls — hard cut to medium profile in vertical 9:16 — an imposing adult shadow stretches from the bag toward Moussa as his smile disappears
shots.pose: Shoulders raised, one foot halted
shots.action: He recoils from the approaching shadow
shots.background_mood: Market warmth darkens into ominous contrast

shots.text: By the end of this story, you should learn how to say what is inside something with il y a,
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — vertical 9:16 educational graphic of an open painted bag containing simple objects, centered text reading "il y a = there is" in Comic Sans MS, painterly 3D animated illustration with warm amber highlights
shots.pose: No character; objects arranged vertically
shots.background_mood: Bright, playful, classroom-like clarity

shots.text: how to say "not" with ne... pas,
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — hard cut to an angled vertical 9:16 grammar ribbon in painterly 3D animated illustration — Comic Sans MS text "ne ... pas" closes around a central verb like two brackets
shots.pose: No character; bracket-like word placement
shots.action: The two words wrap around verb
shots.background_mood: Clean cream field with coral accents

shots.text: and everyday words like le marché, la clé and l'argent.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — cut to overhead painted vocabulary tiles in vertical 9:16 — market stall, key, and coins appear together with Comic Sans MS labels "le marché", "la clé", and "l'argent"
shots.pose: No character; three stacked vocabulary tiles
shots.action: Icons settle beside their French labels
shots.background_mood: Colorful, orderly, easy to scan

shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, slim short sixteen-year-old boy with alert forward posture, rounded face, large dark almond eyes, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow — vertical 9:16 medium portrait at the market entrance, wearing coral T-shirt, navy shorts, mustard sneakers, faded blue satchel
shots.pose: Standing loosely with one hand pocketed
shots.background_mood: Fresh morning light and lively color

shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — hard cut to a high-angle vertical 9:16 insert of Moussa's phone calendar showing "LUNDI" in Comic Sans MS, painterly 3D animated illustration; his woven-bracelet hand lowers the screen
shots.pose: Phone held loosely near his waist
shots.background_mood: Sunny normality with subtle dramatic irony

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, rounded face and large almond eyes — cut to wide vertical 9:16 establishing view from above the stalls — Moussa threads through shoppers beneath striped awnings
shots.expression: Relaxed and absorbed by market activity
shots.pose: Walking between crowded produce stands
shots.action: He moves deeper into the market
shots.background_mood: Energetic stalls, sunbeams, saturated produce

shots.text: Par terre, il y a un sac noir.
shots.scene_description: OBJECT DETAIL — vertical 9:16 ground-level close shot of a plain black zippered bag beside a vegetable crate, Moussa's mustard sneakers stopping behind it, painterly 3D animated illustration with textured sunlit brushwork
shots.pose: Feet stopped just behind the bag
shots.action: The abandoned bag blocks his path
shots.background_mood: Busy market softened behind suspicious stillness

shots.text: Il n'y a pas de nom sur le sac.
shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — hard cut to extreme side insert of the black bag in vertical 9:16, painterly 3D animated illustration — Moussa's bracelet-wearing hand rotates the blank luggage tag, revealing no writing
shots.pose: Only his examining hand enters frame
shots.action: He flips over the blank tag
shots.background_mood: Shallow focus isolates the mystery

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, large almond eyes focused beneath short tight curls — cut to over-the-shoulder vertical 9:16 view — crouching Moussa pulls the zipper open while the bag remains grounded beside the crate
shots.pose: Crouched low beside the vegetable crate
shots.background_mood: Market bustle muffled by concentrated suspense

shots.text: Dans le sac, il y a un téléphone, une clé et beaucoup d'argent.
shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — cut to direct overhead vertical 9:16 insert inside the opened bag, painterly 3D animated illustration — a smartphone, single silver key, and thick bundles of cash are clearly visible together
shots.expression: No visible face; discovery drives suspense
shots.pose: His hands hold the bag open
shots.action: All three contents are revealed together
shots.background_mood: Warm money highlights against deep black

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, rounded face and huge dark almond eyes — push in to extreme close-up in vertical 9:16 — Moussa's eyebrows leap and mouth opens, heightened astonishment held
shots.pose: Face frozen above the open bag
shots.background_mood: Background bursts into warm painted blur

shots.text: Le sac n'est pas à lui.
shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, notched eyebrow pinched above uneasy almond eyes — hard cut to medium side profile in vertical 9:16 — Moussa withdraws both hands from the open bag
shots.pose: Crouched back with palms raised
shots.action: He refuses to touch the contents
shots.background_mood: Warm light meets a cooler moral tension

shots.edit_instruction: ENVIRONMENT — cut to Moussa's leftward point-of-view down a narrow vertical 9:16 market aisle, painterly 3D animated illustration — swaying fabric and unattended produce stands reveal no approaching owner
shots.pose: Off-screen, still crouched beside bag
shots.background_mood: Crowded textures but strangely ownerless

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, short curls and rounded face seen from behind — hard cut to reverse over-the-shoulder vertical 9:16 angle — Moussa snaps right toward a sunlit row of departing shoppers
shots.pose: Crouched body twisting sharply right
shots.background_mood: Moving crowd offers no clear answer

shots.edit_instruction: ENVIRONMENT — cut to high crane-like vertical 9:16 wide shot in painterly 3D animated illustration — Moussa and the open bag sit isolated in a temporary clearing between flowing market crowds
shots.pose: Crouched at the clearing's center
shots.background_mood: Crowds flow past without noticing

shots.scene_description: OBJECT DETAIL — vertical 9:16 macro shot of the smartphone vibrating atop the cash inside the open black bag, painted sound ripples striking the zipper, painterly 3D animated illustration with sharp amber highlights
shots.expression: No visible face; surprise is immediate
shots.pose: Moussa's hand hovers above frame
shots.background_mood: Abrupt energy fractures the quiet suspense

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, rounded face and wary almond eyes — cut to low medium vertical 9:16 angle — Moussa lifts the ringing phone to his ear while remaining beside the bag
shots.pose: Half-standing with phone at ear
shots.background_mood: Market movement blurs behind tense stillness

shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, tall broad-shouldered middle-aged man with formal upright posture, long oval face, deep-set brown eyes, rectangular glasses, strong brows, trimmed moustache — vertical 9:16 shadowed profile in a school office, phone at his ear, wearing deep teal suit, cream shirt, burgundy tie
shots.pose: Standing rigidly beside his desk
shots.background_mood: Cool office shadows conceal his identity

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, rectangular glasses above intent deep-set eyes — hard cut to desk-level three-quarter vertical 9:16 view — Monsieur Koné checks the empty space beside his chair and gestures while describing the missing bag
shots.pose: Leaning slightly toward the empty space
shots.action: He explains that his bag is missing
shots.background_mood: Orderly office disrupted by one absence

shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, slim short sixteen-year-old boy with alert forward posture, rounded face, large dark almond eyes, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow — vertical 9:16 close reaction at the market, phone pressed to ear, wearing coral T-shirt, navy shorts, mustard sneakers, faded blue satchel
shots.pose: Body stiffening above the open bag
shots.background_mood: Market color drains into cool tension

shots.text: C'est Monsieur Koné, le directeur de son école !
shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, tall broad-shouldered middle-aged man with formal upright posture, long oval face, deep-set brown eyes, rectangular glasses, strong brows, trimmed moustache — vertical 9:16 frontal reveal in his school office beside a director plaque, wearing deep teal suit, cream shirt, burgundy tie
shots.pose: Standing squarely behind the desk
shots.action: The school director is fully revealed
shots.background_mood: Cool institutional order with dramatic emphasis

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, deep-set eyes warming behind rectangular glasses — cut to intimate three-quarter close-up in vertical 9:16 — Monsieur Koné smiles broadly and relaxes his shoulders upon hearing the bag is safe
shots.pose: Shoulders lowering, free hand over heart
shots.action: He thanks Moussa over the phone
shots.background_mood: Office warms with golden relief

shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, slim short sixteen-year-old boy with alert forward posture, rounded face, large dark almond eyes, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow — vertical 9:16 medium-wide market shot, Moussa closes the bag protectively while holding the phone, wearing coral T-shirt, navy shorts, mustard sneakers, faded blue satchel
shots.pose: Kneeling protectively beside the bag
shots.background_mood: Warm honest glow amid busy stalls

shots.text: Mais il y a un problème.
shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, notched eyebrow lifting over suddenly anxious eyes — hard cut to low close-up in vertical 9:16 — Moussa's proud smile falters as the caller continues speaking
shots.pose: Frozen with phone against his ear
shots.background_mood: Golden market light gains cool shadows

shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — cut to tilted vertical 9:16 insert of the phone's call screen over a Monday calendar notification reading "LUNDI" in Comic Sans MS, painterly 3D animated illustration; Moussa's fingers tighten around it
shots.expression: His tension registers through gripping fingers
shots.pose: Phone held tightly near his cheek
shots.background_mood: Cool blue screen against warm market

shots.text: Monsieur Koné demande pourquoi Moussa n'est pas à l'école.
shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, tall broad-shouldered middle-aged man with formal upright posture, long oval face, deep-set brown eyes, rectangular glasses, strong brows, trimmed moustache — vertical 9:16 over-desk shot with empty classroom visible through the office window, wearing deep teal suit, cream shirt, burgundy tie
shots.pose: Leaning forward with one brow raised
shots.background_mood: Orderly school setting sharpens the contradiction

shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, slim short sixteen-year-old boy with alert forward posture, rounded face, large dark almond eyes now shut, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow — vertical 9:16 tight market close-up, phone at ear, wearing coral T-shirt, navy shorts, mustard sneakers, faded blue satchel
shots.expression: Cornered, ashamed, searching for an excuse
shots.pose: Eyes shut, chin tucked, shoulders tense
shots.action: He closes his eyes before answering
shots.background_mood: Crowd dissolves into anxious painted blur

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, rounded face and pinched notched eyebrow — hard cut to side-profile medium shot in vertical 9:16 — Moussa forces a weak cough into his fist while speaking into the phone
shots.pose: Hunched theatrically with hand near mouth
shots.background_mood: Comic discomfort under bright market sunlight

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, healthy bright almond eyes and rounded face — cut to energetic wide vertical 9:16 view — a vendor tosses Moussa an orange and he catches it reflexively, exposing perfect health
shots.expression: Caught between reflexive joy and guilt
shots.pose: Standing upright with arm extended
shots.action: He catches the fruit with ease
shots.background_mood: Bright comic reveal with lively motion

shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, slim short sixteen-year-old boy with alert posture now shrinking, rounded face, large dark almond eyes, short tight curls, notched left eyebrow — vertical 9:16 freeze-frame close-up holding phone and orange, wearing coral T-shirt, navy shorts, mustard sneakers, faded blue satchel
shots.pose: Orange raised, shoulders curling inward
shots.action: He realizes how suspicious he looks
shots.background_mood: Humorous spotlight isolates his predicament

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, earnest almond eyes beneath short tight curls — cut to high three-quarter vertical 9:16 view — Moussa places the secured black bag safely atop the vendor's counter
shots.pose: Both hands carefully presenting the bag
shots.background_mood: Warm amber light rewards honesty

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, notched eyebrow twitching above guilty eyes — hard cut to low-angle medium vertical 9:16 shot — Moussa hides the healthy orange behind his back while fake-coughing into the phone
shots.pose: One hand hidden behind his back
shots.action: He continues the weak illness performance
shots.background_mood: Playful irony with cool guilty shadows

shots.text: Remember: il y a means "there is",
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — vertical 9:16 painterly educational card showing an open bag and one glowing phone, centered Comic Sans MS text reading "il y a = there is", textured brushwork and warm classroom colors
shots.pose: No character; phrase centered above bag
shots.action: The phone appears inside the bag
shots.background_mood: Calm, bright, and instructional

shots.text: and to say "not", you wrap ne... pas around the verb:
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — hard cut to diagonal vertical 9:16 grammar diagram in painterly 3D animated illustration — Comic Sans MS words "ne" and "pas" slide to opposite sides of a glowing verb
shots.pose: No character; words form visual brackets
shots.background_mood: Cream field with blue and coral cues

shots.edit_instruction: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION, healthy rounded face and wide dark almond eyes — cut to vertical 9:16 medium portrait of Moussa holding the orange, with Comic Sans MS sentence "Moussa n'est pas malade" aligned safely below him and "n'" plus "pas" highlighted
shots.pose: Standing upright with orange in hand
shots.action: The example sentence labels the truth
shots.background_mood: Friendly correction with humorous warmth

shots.text: What do you think Mr Koné says next?
shots.scene_description: PAINTERLY 3D ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION WITH TEXTURED BRUSHWORK, tall broad-shouldered middle-aged man with formal upright posture, long oval face, deep-set brown eyes, rectangular glasses, strong brows, trimmed moustache — vertical 9:16 suspenseful office close-up, phone lowered slightly, wearing deep teal suit, cream shirt, burgundy tie
shots.expression: Skeptical silence with one raised eyebrow
shots.pose: Still, phone hovering near his mouth
shots.background_mood: Cool suspense with a warm desk lamp

shots.text: Tell us in French in the comments.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — hard cut to vertical 9:16 painted stack of blank speech bubbles and accent-mark symbols, painterly 3D animated illustration — centered Comic Sans MS prompt reads "Répondez en français !"
shots.pose: No character; speech bubbles rise upward
shots.action: A cursor blinks inside one bubble
shots.background_mood: Cheerful coral and amber engagement

shots.text: See you in the next story.
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — vertical 9:16 painterly end card with the closed black bag resting beside a winding path toward a glowing market skyline, centered Comic Sans MS text reading "À bientôt !", textured warm highlights and deep-blue shadows
shots.pose: No character; bag anchors lower frame
shots.background_mood: Gentle sunset promise of another story
